wintun.role: Windows TUN/Wintun-class L3 capture device only; never part of the frozen WBD transport semantics

source_reference.reason: Current upstream source reference includes the 2026 Ring->Head race fix and missed-wakeup memory-barrier fix. Do not float this reference during qualification.

official_signed_compatibility_artifact.reason: The currently published signed package predates the 2026 upstream ring-race fixes and therefore must not silently become the V2.2 release authority.

wintun.release_binary_policy: Use only an official/suitably signed Wintun binary whose exact archive or DLL hash is locked here. Before declaring Windows release-qualified, either obtain a signed artifact that includes the pinned 2026 source fixes or record an explicit risk-acceptance decision for the older official signed package. Self-built unsigned/test-signed Wintun is not a release artifact.
wintun.integration: Load wintun.dll dynamically and bind only the documented public Wintun API. Keep device/route lifecycle outside the frozen WBD transport.

licenses.official_prebuilt: permissive prebuilt-binaries license included by upstream
